days.title: Observational warm-up: the hand
days.description: Spend 15 minutes observing your non-dominant hand. Focus on the lines, folds, and shadows. Try to mentally 'trace' its outline.
days.tip: Break down complex forms into simpler shapes like cylinders and spheres

days.title: Basic line exercises
days.description: On paper, practice drawing straight lines, curved lines, and circles without rulers or compasses. Aim for smooth, consistent strokes.
days.tip: Draw from your shoulder, not just your wrist, for straighter lines

days.title: Form and perspective: the cube
days.description: Draw 5 cubes from different angles. Focus on making the lines parallel and converging correctly to create a sense of depth.
days.tip: Use light 'construction lines' first, then darken the final lines

days.title: Shading fundamentals: the sphere
days.description: Draw a circle and use cross-hatching or blending to shade it, creating the illusion of a 3D sphere with a light source.
days.tip: Establish your light source first and consistently apply shadows away from it

days.title: Sketching household objects
days.description: Choose 3 simple objects (e.g., a mug, a book, an apple). Sketch them quickly, focusing on their basic shapes and proportions.
days.tip: Squinting at your subject helps simplify it into basic shapes and values

days.title: Texture exploration
days.description: Find 3 different textures (e.g., wood grain, fabric, metal). Try to replicate their visual texture using various pencil strokes.
days.tip: Varying pressure and line direction helps create different textural effects

days.title: Week 1 sketchbook review
days.description: Look through all your drawings from this week. Identify your favorite piece and one area you want to improve next week.
days.tip: Compare your early work to later pieces to see your progress, not just flaws
